posts.title: Bengio: ‘If you prioritize safety, leave frontier AI companies’
posts.description: We have a choice in front of us. In his latest op-ed for Transformer, Yoshua Bengio invites employees of frontier AI companies to ask themselves if their work is truly leading us toward a safer future. Reflecting on these questions is hard, but we no longer have the luxury of time. We must act now.

posts.title: The dangerous myth behind AI agent hacks

posts.title: Professor Yoshua Bengio’s speech at the UN Security Council
posts.description: In this speech, Professor Yoshua Bengio addresses the UN Security Council to discuss the unprecedented threat posed by uncontrolled frontier AI. Humanity has summoned the courage and wisdom to manage catastrophic risks before. This is one of those moments, far bigger than any personal, commercial, or national interest. The choices we make about this technology today will shape generations to come.
